item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 07/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier with a few showers over the region. A southerly airstream is expected to bring hot weather and a few showers to the coast of southern China over the weekend and early next week. A trough of low pressure will affect Guangdong early next week.
